profile_text.body:
Aleph Alpha is a European AI company that develops specialized language models and AI solutions for businesses and public institutions in Europe. The company describes itself as focused on sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI, with its infrastructure hosted within the EU and its models designed for multilingual use. Its core model family is called Luminous.

The company's site cites several deployment outcomes: an AI assistant introduced at a government agency serving 80,000 users to accelerate administrative processes, an AI agent applied to sensitive documents at a global chip manufacturer that reduced search times by 90 percent, and AI-assisted requirements engineering at an automotive supplier that led to 40 percent faster RFQ processing. These examples reflect Aleph Alpha's stated focus on enterprise and public-sector use cases involving regulated or sensitive data.

The site's held facts list Aleph Alpha's product under the category of chat and general large language models, noting its European sovereign positioning and GDPR-first approach. No litigation, patent filings, SEC disclosures, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the available data.
